Social psychology provides a specific empirical perspective on persons and moral judgment. The programme combines philosophical reading and argument with interdisciplinary cases while retaining important specialist gaps.

alternativeSelection.assessment: Three concepts pass sequential tests after reconstruction of weak contributions. The strongest broad option combines direct philosophical subjects/methods with specifically relevant interpretation andsocialtheory; generic archaeology andschool-based rhetoric are removed. Political/social philosophy adds concrete legal,justice andsocial-institution study,withformal logic replacing an unrelated Americanhistoryresearch seminar. Mind/language retainsphilosophicalcore andadds empiricalneuroscience,language andcomputationalmethodstudy,withpoliticalphilosophy replacing excessivepersuasionstudy. Theformalentrepreneurshiptrack remains recorded asmaximum-reached after three valid distinct alternatives; no forced fourthslot.

comparisonAlignment.rationale: Introduction to Western Philosophy studies ancient sources and later philosophical arguments. This is a direct partial philosophical-history relationship; a complete ancient-and-medieval survey is not claimed.
UCR Ethics includes Kant and close philosophical reading, but is already assigned to introductory ethics. It is not repeated as an identical dedicated six-EC Kant course.
No selected UCR course directly reproduces Tilburg’s dedicated Kritiek van de Instrumentele Rede component.
No selected UCR course directly reproduces Tilburg’s dedicated Existentialisme en Structuralisme component.
No selected UCR course directly reproduces Tilburg’s dedicated Hedendaagse Fenomenologie component.
Modern History provides historical context, but its primary subject is not the history of philosophical arguments. The dedicated modern-philosophy component is kept separate.
The removed archaeology course supplied contextual material, not direct cultural-philosophy study. Specific literary and social-theory complements remain, without a forced component match.
Ethics directly examines moral theories, duties and judgments central to Tilburg’s compulsory Ethics course.
Introduction to Political Philosophy directly examines normative political questions central to Tilburg’s Political Philosophy course.

AI Ethics explicitly applies ethical frameworks to fairness, privacy, responsibility and moral status. It supplies a direct contemporary applied-ethics relationship without matching every Tilburg application.
No selected UCR course directly reproduces Tilburg’s dedicated Hedendaagse Sociale en Politieke Filosofie component.
European Union Politics studies empirical institutions and policymaking. The current evidence does not establish the primary philosophical content of this dedicated Political Topics course.
Philosophy of Mind directly addresses consciousness, personal identity and mind–body relations.

Philosophy of Emotion directly examines emotion, knowledge, moral judgment and action. These are identifiable parts of moral psychology; the course also covers wider emotional and aesthetic experience.
Free Will, Time & the Self addresses metaphysical questions about time, agency and personal identity, while narrower than Tilburg’s general Metaphysics course.
No selected UCR course directly reproduces Tilburg’s dedicated Wijsgerige Antropologie component.

Propositional and quantified logic, valid inference and proof directly address formal reasoning. The additional mathematical material is not treated as a full philosophical-argumentation syllabus.

notes.text: Tilburg provides a sustained philosophy curriculum with dedicated history of philosophy, epistemology, metaphysics, philosophical methods and language study, followed by the general Philosophy track and a required 10-EC thesis. The UCR options combine substantive philosophy with other fields and retain important specialist gaps. Optional independent research is additional to the displayed 180 EC and is not a required philosophy thesis.

audience.programmeDescription: Philosophy at Tilburg University studies ethics, philosophical anthropology and psychology, political and social philosophy, and philosophy of science and knowledge. Historical and contemporary philosophical texts support argument, interpretation and independent research.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The UCR options connect philosophical study with social and literary interpretation, normative questions about institutions, or empirical mind and language research. They address related questions through different disciplines, while leaving gaps in Tilburg’s dedicated history, epistemology, metaphysics and philosophical-methods sequence. Shared rows indicate partial relationships rather than course equivalence.

curriculum.limitation: The pathway includes 30 EC of genuine choice space and a required 10-EC thesis. First-year mentoring carries 1 EC; second-year mentoring carries 0 EC. The Entrepreneurship track is a different route and is not combined with this pathway.
